exceptions.rationale: The affected esbuild development server is present only through drizzle-kit tooling. Generated commands use drizzle-kit generate and migrate and never invoke esbuild serve.
exceptions.mitigation: Keep the development server API unexposed and re-evaluate the chain whenever drizzle-kit or its loader dependencies change.

exceptions.rationale: The advisory affects unstable React Server Components APIs. The official Power Apps starter is a Vite browser SPA that uses createBrowserRouter and does not enable RSC mode.
exceptions.mitigation: Keep unstable RSC APIs outside generated and documented behavior and adopt the official compatible React Router fix when react-router-dom exposes it.

exceptions.rationale: The affected uuid APIs are buffered v3, v5, and v6 calls. The pinned MSAL implementation imports uuid v4 only.
exceptions.mitigation: Do not introduce buffered uuid calls and adopt the Microsoft Power Apps CLI update when it moves to an MSAL release without the affected uuid dependency.

exceptions.rationale: The dependency is development-only and the official starter invokes ESLint with the fixed literal path argument '.', not an attacker-controlled brace or glob pattern.
exceptions.mitigation: Keep lint arguments maintainer-controlled and adopt the official starter's compatible ESLint toolchain update when available.
